title: Segmentation fault when printing message to stdout

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

milestone.title: needs-owner
milestone.description: We don't plan to work on this, but will accept high quality contributions from someone who will own the feature and follow up on bug reports.

body:
- Neovim version: Master (0.1.5-69-g81e0874)
  **Not present in 0.1.4**
- Operating system/version: Gentoo Linux (Hardened Musl x86_64)
- Terminal name/version: st 0.6
- `$TERM`: st-256color
### Actual behaviour

Segmentation fault when a message is printed to stderr.
### Expected behaviour

No segfault!
### Steps to reproduce:

Because I don't know of an easier way to test this, this is what I used (After finding #4662):
1. Have the following in init.vim:

``` viml
call
```
1. try to start nvim
